3558-5006-7272-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-7272-8170.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
3558-5006-7272-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2390-3966-5877.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-3966-5877.description:
Gain life.
Vampire Scrivener triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

936-2302-5099-7863--165.easyPrerequisites:
"Black" chosen with Painter's Servant.
You have a way to draw a card.
936-2302-5099-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Mindcrank triggers, causing that player to mill a card.
Since the card is black due to Painter's Servant, Compost triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until your library is empty or you decline to draw a card.

553-2093-7735.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Quicksilver.
In response, cast Lapse of Certainty by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

2103-5913-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak from exile to the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

3375-4399-4518-6752.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3375-4399-4518-6752.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3680-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3680-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Stunt Double and Sakashima's Student each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3680-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1417-2946-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1417-2946-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1263-2301-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1008-1619-2034-4605-5542.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1008-1619-2034-4605-5542.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Undermountain Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Undermountain Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Undermountain Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Undermountain Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Undermountain Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Undermountain Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1008-1619-2034-4605-5542.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1308-2457-4289-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4681-5170-6794-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4682-5140-5184-6753.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-5140-5184-6753.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Xorn and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4682-5140-5184-6753.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2292-4452-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
2292-4452-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-3000-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-2478-4785.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-4907-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

394-3705-5231-6896.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2376-3327-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2376-3327-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

4050-4210-5544.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and gaining 1 life.
Repeat.

3946-4426-4572.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

654-880-3678.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-3678.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1636-2108-2574-5220.notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2108-2574-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Etched Familiar.
When Etched Familiar dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Etched Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life andyou to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Etched Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Etched Familiar from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Etched Familiar enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1308-1339-3265-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1308-1339-3265-4871.description:
Activate Dockside Chef by paying {1}{B} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Dockside Chef ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1110-2034-2343-3490.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal non-lethal damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
1110-2034-2343-3490.description:
Deal damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
Siegehorn Ceratops triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Terror of the Peaks.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to Siegehorn Ceratops.
Repeat from step 2.

1053-2890-3990-4019-4892.description:
Cast Flash putting Protean Hulk into play and choose not to pay.
Protean Hulk is sacrificed.
Grab Vigean Graftmage, Incubation Druid, & Torch Courier.
Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability triggers, move a counter to Incubation Druid.
Sacrifice Torch Courier to give Incubation Druid haste.
Tap Incubation Druid for {U}{U}{U} and untap it with Vigean Graftmage, netting {U}.
Repeat for infinite {U}.
You can now untap Incubation Druid as much as you want to get infinite of your other colors.

1987-2510-4125-4792.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-4125-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
